plastic_zone.depth_max_note: the largest normal distance of ANY yielding integration point, over the whole excavation line rather than in the four station bands: it is the depth a mesh has to stay adequate to
plastic_zone.slip_note: max_plastic_slip_m is gamma_p times the band width at the hottest point -- right units, one sample; gamma_p_integral_m2 is sum gamma_p * w_q over the rock, which for a band of width h, length L and slip u is u L with no h in it, and is the robust mesh-comparable measure
